newsitem.title: USA: Alcohol Sensors CEO Whitney resigns.
newsitem.headline: Alcohol Sensors CEO Whitney resigns.

text.p: Alcohol Sensors International Ltd said Monday that Robert Whitney, its chief executive officer and director, who recently underwent back surgery, has resigned from both positions.

The company, which makes safety devices such as automotive ignition interlocks designed to prevent individuals who are drunk from driving, said Whitney has agreed to make himself available to the company if requested.
An official said the company is in the process of naming a replacement for Whitney.
